Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Prime Minister of Armenia Nikol Pashinyan
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
We have always supported and continue to support
the development of friendly and mutually beneficial relations with Armenia
, based on the principles of strategic partnership and alliance.
Russia is the Republic’s leading trade and economic partner
, accounting for
around 30% of its trade
, as well as a major investor in Armenia’s economy. In the first half of 2026, bilateral trade reached
$2.5 billion
.
Russian companies are among the largest taxpayers in Armenia
, creating jobs, transferring advanced technologies and strengthening the country’s energy security.
I would also note that you and I have discussed on a number of occasions
matters related to Armenia’s stated intention to join the EU
, both
by telephone
and
in person
.
☝️
You are well aware of Russia’s position:
Armenia’s aspiration to join the EU
is the natural and legitimate right of the country and its people
. Armenia is a sovereign state, and it is for the Armenian people to determine the path of their development.
At the same time, this undoubtedly creates difficulties for Armenia’s continued membership in
the Eurasian Economic Union
(
#EAEU
) and
risks nullifying the advantages
the Republic enjoys in the EAEU market and
disrupting established trade chains
.
📈
Meanwhile, over more than 10 years of participation in Eurasian integration processes,
Armenia’s GDP has nearly tripled: from $10.6 billion in 2015 to $29.2 billion in 2025
– at least according to our statistics. Exports to the EAEU countries
have increased tenfold
, and today the EAEU accounts for
around 36%
of Armenia’s foreign trade.
Therefore, of course,
the people of Armenia should clearly express their view
on the country’s future political and economic course
. At the same time, as we have discussed, any corresponding decisions should be approached strictly objectively and based on realities.
I remember that you publicly said you considered it necessary to hold a referendum on this issue
, and
I supported your position at the latest meeting of the Supreme Eurasian Economic Council
. I specifically mentioned that Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan had announced this publicly and urged our colleagues to support it as well.
👉
The sooner we determine the way forward, the better
, because we also need to understand how to develop our relations with Armenia, above all in the economic sphere.
Some regulatory matters
– agricultural products, various technical norms and standards, for example –
are fundamentally different in the EAEU and the EU
.
I hope that today, in a calm, friendly and businesslike atmosphere, we will discuss all these matters.

#RussiaArmenia

item.title: 🇷🇺 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting with President of Mongolia Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh

We are also seeing positive results this year: in the first half of 2026, trade grew by more than 18% . That is a strong indicator. the 105th anniversary of the establishment of
diplomatic relations

actively
and, in my view,
very intensively and effectively
.

regular contact

item.title: 🇷🇺 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting with President of Turkiye Recep Tayyip Erdogan
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇹🇷 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the meeting with President of Turkiye Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Bishkek, September 1, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am very glad to meet with you again. It has indeed been quite some time since we last met in person , although we continue to keep our bilateral relations under close review . Turkiye is one of our privileged partners both in foreign policy and in the economic sphere . The Intergovernmental Commission is working actively. Thanks to your personal attention to the development of our ties, economic cooperation remains at a high level. Major joint projects are continuing . One of the best known is the Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant . It is being built in Turkiye, and you tasked our company Rosatom with launching the first unit this year – and that is exactly what will happen. The company is on schedule . There is also considerable potential for expanding cooperation in the cultural and humanitarian sphere . The number of Russian tourists visiting Turkiye continues to grow. In 2025, the figure reached nearly 7 million people . 🤝 Today we have an opportunity to discuss these and all other issues of mutual interest. #RussiaTurkiye

🇷🇺
🇮🇷
Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian
(Bishkek, September 1, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
I am very pleased
to see you again
, this time here at the SCO Summit in Kyrgyzstan. As you know, we use
every opportunity
to meet, talk and hold consultations.
Friendly Russia-Iran relations continue to develop steadily across all areas,
in keeping with the letter and spirit of
the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
.
☝️
As I have said on many occasions, Russia stands in solidarity with the people of Iran
. We admire your courage and resilience in defending your national interests. Please convey my greetings and sincere words of support to Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic
Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei.
We welcomed the conclusion in June of this year of the Iran-US ceasefire memorandum
, but unfortunately
the ceasefire proved unstable and overly fragile
.
During this difficult period, we have been trying to provide you with the assistance you need. We have discussed this with you, and
we are supplying the necessary goods
.
Despite the military and political situation,
we have maintained last year’s momentum in trade, economic ties and cooperation
. This is due first and foremost to the effective work of the intergovernmental commission, which meets regularly and held another session quite recently.
The free trade agreement between the EAEU and Iran
is also, in my view,
an important factor.
Considerable attention is also being paid to expanding humanitarian cooperation
: more and more Iranian students are choosing to study in Russia, which we are very pleased to see. A large number of future medical professionals are studying in Russia. In the 2025-2026 academic year,
the number of Iranian students in Russia approached 9,000
, including 802 studying at the expense of the Russian federal budget.
🤝
We have many issues to discuss
. I am very pleased to have this opportunity to meet with you and your team today.
#RussiaIran
